svg.title: Molecule of the day: Naproxen
svg.desc: A rotating 3D structure of Naproxen while a graph neural network predicts its lipophilicity (logD) as -0.17.
svg.text: MW 230.3 · cLogP 3.04 · TPSA 46.5 · HBD 1 · HBA 2 · RotB 3
3-layer message-passing GNN · 4,200 molecules · held-out RMSE 0.603 (R² 0.731) · descriptors from RDKit
